runtime_rules.purpose: Represent fixed trap cards referenced by the map and random temporary traps.
draw_triggers: interact with an authored trapped door, passage, chest, or bookshelf
runtime_rules.screen_behavior: The card pops up, places a legal temporary hazard, displays counters, and starts a synchronized countdown.
runtime_rules.disarm: Use a D&D-style Search and tool sequence: detect with Passive Perception or a Search action using Wisdom (Perception), study mechanisms with Intelligence (Investigation) when useful, and disarm a mechanical trap with a Dexterity check using Thieves’ Tools against the trap disable DC. Tool proficiency adds Proficiency Bonus; matching skill proficiency grants Advantage under the revised tool rule. Magical traps may instead allow Intelligence (Arcana), Dispel Magic, a listed spell, or a card-specific counter.
runtime_rules.success: Disable the trap, gain XP, and receive configured Treasure or Gameplay rewards.
runtime_rules.failure: Apply damage, conditions, alarm, separation, lockdown, monster draw, or environmental effects.
runtime_rules.ghost_interaction: Every ghost can trigger an armed trap or spend Haunt Energy to draw and place a new legal Trap card.
runtime_rules.fairness: No random trap may spawn on a protected starting cell, meeting zone, inaccessible tile, or unavoidable no-counterplay route.
runtime_rules.permanent_death: Unused held Trap cards return to the Trap deck. Resolved cards enter discard and reshuffle when needed.

monster_trigger_cards.rule: Some Trap cards do not deal their main effect directly. They instruct the active seat to draw a Monster card, spawn that monster on a valid adjacent or room spawn cell, show its HP bar, and begin initiative.

runtime_rules.monster_ambush: Instead of placing a normal hazard, draw the top Monster card and spawn that monster on the nearest legal unoccupied cell.
runtime_rules.detection_and_disarm: Use the D&D interaction procedure defined in dnd_video_game_engine.search_locks_and_traps.

revealPolicy: Details become visible only when legally drawn, spawned, discovered, or triggered.
